balanced_rf__primary.description: Balanced random forest; each tree undersamples the majority class inside fit (resampling never touches validation or test rows).
balanced_rf__primary.disclaimer: Educational decision-support prototype trained on synthetic PaySim data. Outputs are risk scores and review priorities that help human investigators decide what to review first. This system makes no fraud or AML determination and performs no automatic blocking, account closure, customer risk rating, or regulatory reporting. Results on synthetic data do not establish real-world detection effectiveness, fairness, or regulatory suitability.
